parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The equation x x 4 12 5 0 2 + + = can be written as x k 2 3 2 + = . Find the value of k . k = ................................................ [1]

content.tex: The equation \(4x^{2} +12x+5 = 0\) can be written as \(\begin{pmatrix}2 & x & + & 3\end{pmatrix}^{2} = k\) .

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Use your answer to part(ii) to solve the equation x x 4 12 5 0 2 + + = . x = ................... or x = .................. [2]

content.tex: Use your answer to part(ii) to solve the equation \(4x^{2} +12x+5 = 0\) .

parts.text: (b) x varies inversely as the square root of ( w – 1). When w = 10, x = 2.
